what: String N work cards (2:3) onto a single-row orbit — each card p = (i − now)/N·2π, horizontal sin p × card width, front/back factor m = ((cos p + 1)/2)^1.3 takes cards from .2→1x, blur width ×.04→0, brightness .3→1, and the overlap order changes, and the whole row spins on the stage at 15° per second (cards counter-rotate to stay upright), running only while on screen. On first sight it shows the first card, clicking a list row turns that card to the front the nearest way in .7s, and it widens over .75s to the smaller of stage width .48 (.42 if narrow) and 2/3 of stage height, unfolding the photo masked 25% top and bottom. After that the name tag (.72s), letters (.68s, .018 stagger, .12 late) and ‹View› tag (.58s, .7 late) rise, and the card tilts up to 14° following the cursor (.65s power3.out). The description text goes off at .2s and rises line by line in .7s (.08 stagger). A list row slides in an ink fill over .5s from the side the cursor entered (top or bottom) and the name shifts 16px. Clicking the stage goes to the chosen work (fx:open)

options.spin: Speed at which the lines rotate on the board (°/sec), default 15 — 0 stops it
options.min: Scale of the rearmost card, default .2
options.blur: Rearmost blur (share of card width), default .04
options.tilt: Max tilt of the picked card cursor (°), default 14
